pages.text: These artifacts are in the Shu Pharaoh’s loot pool. Use four matching Torches of Shu to target it. An untuned ritual can also drop them.
A quickdraw bow that charges faster than a normal bow. Useful while moving between shots.
This battleaxe delivers strong knockback with a fully charged hit. Leave a gap between swings to recharge the attack.
Wear this amulet in a Curios necklace slot. It speeds up forward ground movement or sprinting. It does not apply while airborne.
